language.name: Language
language.desc: Choose the interface language. Follows Obsidian by default.
preview.name: Preview animations
preview.desc: Open a preview modal to see the opening and closing effects.
preview.popout: Open a preview modal to see the opening and closing effects. Settings are in a separate window, so the preview may open in the main window.
reset.name: Reset all parameters
reset.desc: Restore all visual and animation defaults. Keep the selected language.
reset.body: All visual and animation parameters will return to their defaults. Your language selection will be kept. This cannot be undone.
blur.name: Blur radius
bg.blur.desc: Background blur when a modal is open. Higher values increase the blur.
bg.dim.name: Dimming
bg.dim.desc: 0% leaves the background unchanged; 100% makes it black.
contrast.name: Contrast
saturation.name: Saturation
bg.scale.name: Background scale
bg.scale.desc: Background size when a modal is open. Above 100% enlarges it; below 100% shrinks it. 100% keeps its original size.
bg.in.name: Background transition duration
bg.in.desc: Time for background effects to appear when a modal opens.
bg.out.name: Background restore duration
bg.out.desc: Time for the background to return to normal when a modal closes.
modal.in.desc: Animation duration when a modal opens.
modal.out.desc: Animation duration when a modal closes.
modal.in.size.desc: Modals scale from this size to their original size. 100% disables scaling.
modal.out.size.desc: Modals scale to this size as they close. 100% disables scaling.
menu.enabled.name: Animate context menus
menu.enabled.desc: Add opening and closing animations to context menus and submenus.
menu.fade.name: Fade-in duration
menu.fade.desc: Time for menus to fade from transparent to fully visible.
menu.slide.name: Slide duration
menu.slide.desc: Time for menus to slide open.
menu.scale.name: Scale duration
menu.scale.desc: Time for menus to reach their original size. Can differ from fade-in and slide durations.
menu.distance.name: Slide distance
menu.distance.desc: Distance menus slide as they open. Follows the menu's opening direction.
menu.in.size.desc: Menus scale from this size to their original size. 100% disables scaling.
menu.out.desc: Animation duration when a menu closes.
menu.out.size.desc: Menus scale to this size as they close. 100% disables scaling.
glass.enabled.name: Enable frosted glass
glass.enabled.desc: Apply frosted glass to modals, the command palette, context menus, and editor suggestions in the main window. Disable if performance suffers.
glass.tint.name: Keep original background color
glass.tint.desc: Keep the original background color of modals, menus, and other overlays. When off, only blur and filters remain.
glass.alpha.name: Background color opacity
glass.alpha.desc: 0% is fully transparent; 100% is fully opaque. Only applies when “Keep original background color” is enabled.
glass.blur.desc: Blur behind the glass, independent of the blur setting in the Background tab.
glass.brightness.name: Background brightness
glass.contrast.name: Background contrast
glass.saturation.name: Background saturation
ease.desc: Choose “Custom” to enter an easing curve (how the animation speed changes).
preview.title: Animation preview
preview.closeHint: Press Esc, click outside the modal, or select Close to preview the closing animation.
preview.liveHint: Settings apply immediately. Reopen the preview to compare effects.
nn.intro: Use horizontal dual panes in Notebook Navigator with narrow-sidebar behavior set to none. The card appears in the desktop left sidebar. Disable the old notebook-navigator-hover-navigation CSS snippet. Number and text fields apply and save on Enter or blur; empty fields restore the current value, and numbers are limited to their allowed range.
nn.nnEnabled.name: Enable hover navigation
nn.nnEnabled.desc: Keep the file list visible; hover over the upper-left icon to open navigation.
nn.nnDragEnabled.name: Open while dragging files
nn.nnDragEnabled.desc: Open at the trigger when dragging from the file list or system file manager, and stay open over navigation.
nn.nnOpenDelay.name: Hover opening delay
nn.nnOpenDelay.desc: Wait before opening when the pointer rests on the trigger.
nn.nnCloseDelay.name: Closing delay
nn.nnCloseDelay.desc: Wait before closing after the pointer or dragged file leaves navigation.
nn.nnDragDelay.name: Drag opening delay
nn.nnDragDelay.desc: Wait before opening when a dragged file rests over the trigger.
nn.nnDrawerWidth.name: Maximum card width
nn.nnDrawerHeight.name: Card height
nn.nnDrawerHeight.desc: Use 600px, 80%, or min(820px, 100%). Longer directory trees scroll within the card.
nn.nnOffsetTop.name: Top offset
nn.nnOffsetLeft.name: Left offset
nn.nnBottomGap.name: Bottom space
nn.nnExitStrip.name: Visible file list strip
nn.nnExitStrip.desc: Leave part of the file list visible on the right for moving the pointer out of the card.
nn.nnButtonCardGap.name: Button-to-card gap
nn.nnCardRadius.name: Card corner radius
nn.nnContentRadius.name: Content corner radius
nn.nnPaddingTop.name: Content top padding
nn.nnPaddingInline.name: Content side padding
nn.nnPaddingBottom.name: Content bottom padding
nn.nnGlassEnabled.name: Frosted navigation card
nn.nnGlassEnabled.desc: Control the navigation card independently. Turn off for an opaque surface.
nn.nnGlassOpacity.name: Background color opacity
nn.nnGlassBlur.name: Background blur
nn.nnGlassBlur.desc: Higher values blur the background behind the glass more.
nn.nnGlassBrightness.name: Background brightness
nn.nnGlassBrightness.desc: 1 preserves the original level; higher values increase it, lower values reduce it.
nn.nnGlassSaturation.name: Background saturation
nn.nnGlassSaturation.desc: 1 preserves the original level; higher values increase it, lower values reduce it.
nn.nnGlassContrast.name: Background contrast
nn.nnGlassContrast.desc: 1 preserves the original level; higher values increase it, lower values reduce it.
nn.nnSlideDistance.name: Slide distance
nn.nnClosedScale.name: Closed scale
nn.nnClosedScale.desc: 1 keeps the original size; 0.985 means 98.5% of the original size.
nn.nnScaleOrigin.name: Scale origin
nn.nnScaleOrigin.desc: Use top left, top center, or another CSS position.
nn.nnEnterFadeDuration.name: Fade-in duration
nn.nnEnterFadeDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnEnterSlideDuration.name: Opening slide duration
nn.nnEnterSlideDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnEnterScaleDuration.name: Opening scale duration
nn.nnEnterScaleDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnEnterEasing.name: Opening easing
nn.nnExitFadeDuration.name: Fade-out duration
nn.nnExitFadeDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnExitSlideDuration.name: Closing slide duration
nn.nnExitSlideDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnExitScaleDuration.name: Closing scale duration
nn.nnExitScaleDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnExitEasing.name: Closing easing
nn.nnCardSurface.name: Card surface color
nn.nnCardSurface.desc: Use a color or theme variable, such as #6bbfdb or var(--text-muted).
nn.nnCardBorderWidth.name: Border width
nn.nnCardBorderColor.name: Border color
nn.nnCardBorderColor.desc: Use a color or theme variable, such as #6bbfdb or var(--text-muted).
nn.nnCardShadow.name: Card shadow
nn.nnCardShadow.desc: Enter a CSS box-shadow value, or none to disable the shadow.
nn.nnShadowSpace.name: Shadow clearance
nn.nnShadowSpace.desc: Increase with larger shadows to leave room for their edges.
nn.nnLayer.name: Stacking order
nn.nnLayer.desc: Higher values bring the card forward within the sidebar.
nn.nnButtonIcon.name: Trigger icon
nn.nnButtonIcon.desc: Uses panel-left by default. Accepts an SVG icon in url(...) format.
nn.nnButtonIconSize.name: Icon size
nn.nnButtonWidth.name: Button width
nn.nnButtonHeight.name: Button height
nn.nnToolbarHeight.name: Toolbar alignment height
nn.nnToolbarHeight.desc: Vertically center the button within this height.
nn.nnButtonOffsetY.name: Button vertical adjustment
nn.nnButtonOffsetY.desc: Positive values move down; negative values move up.
nn.nnButtonColor.name: Icon color
nn.nnButtonColor.desc: Use a color or theme variable, such as #6bbfdb or var(--text-muted).
nn.nnButtonHoverColor.name: Hovered icon color
nn.nnButtonHoverColor.desc: Use a color or theme variable, such as #6bbfdb or var(--text-muted).
nn.nnButtonOpacity.name: Icon opacity
nn.nnButtonHoverOpacity.name: Hovered icon opacity
nn.nnButtonHoverBg.name: Button hover background
nn.nnButtonHoverBg.desc: Use a color or theme variable, such as #6bbfdb or var(--text-muted).
nn.nnButtonRadius.name: Button corner radius
nn.nnButtonRadius.desc: Use 4px, or var(--radius-s, 4px) to follow the theme.
nn.nnToolbarGap.name: Button-to-toolbar gap
nn.nnButtonDuration.name: Button highlight duration
nn.nnButtonDuration.desc: Higher values slow the transition; 0 makes it immediate.
nn.nnButtonEasing.name: Button highlight easing
